explanation.customer:
You asked about: CoatingChange (part CL-115, new coating COAT-ZN-YELLOW, scope series), checked as of 2026-11-14.
Result: the change cannot go ahead as proposed: at least one blocker was found.
What stops it:
- CoatingChange on CL-115 needs written customer approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping, per CSR-AUR-R4 (documents: CSR-AUR-R4, REG-CUSTOMERS, REG-PARTS, REG-PROGRAMS)
- CoatingChange on CL-115 needs written customer approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping, per CSR-NOR-R2 (documents: CSR-NOR-R2, REG-CUSTOMERS, REG-PARTS, REG-PROGRAMS)
- Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation contains Hexavalent chromium, Cr(VI), restricted by LAW-ELV for vehicles sold in the market of CL-115 (documents: LAW-ELV, REG-COATINGS, REG-PARTS, REG-PROGRAMS)
Who decides: the plant quality manager. The check does not approve anything.
Possible next steps: stop.
What would change the result (hypothetical, each verified by re-running the same check):
- If a valid deviation granted by the customer for CoatingChange on CL-115 (supplier SUP-G): 2 blockers would go.
- If the request asks for Sulphuric acid anodising, clear (COAT-ANOD) instead of Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation (the rules check restricted substances only, not whether the coating suits the base material): 1 blocker would go.
With these 2 hypothetical changes the table row would be D11: no blockers found — still not an approval.
